name: simulate_architectural_change
description: Simulate architectural modifications (service decomposition, adding/removing dependencies, deleting nodes) and compare metrics against the baseline.

mapping.description: For decompose: mapping of node_id/path to service name.

node_id.description: For remove_node: node id, path, or name to delete.

source.description: For dependencies: source node id or name.

target.description: For dependencies: target node id or name.

context.description: Optional: Specific CGC context to use.

repo_path.description: Path to the repository (defaults to current workspace).
